status: code-done, PR open, NOT merged, NOT deployed
missionPremise: Ruling 1 (operator-approved 2026-08-19) and its implementation in src/fixture-seam.mjs: 'A domain that is NOT in the registry is the fifth state and it has no entry here on purpose: absent from the registry means the surface does not exist, which is the only surviving meaning of Not built.' Three rendering lanes (G-97 R1/R2/R3) shipped Development services, Fleet, Public works, Police and Fire and EMS, which made four nav badges and one register group in web/index.html false. R2 and R3 ROUTED both findings rather than stretching scope into sections they did not own. The premise this lane rests on is not that the words were wrong; it is that a state claim was hand-declared where nothing connected it to the thing that decides it, which is the has_writer defect class this programme has already paid for twice.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without the lane: (1) no lens the domain registry declares carries a Not built claim anywhere in web/index.html - nav badge, page chip, or Overview register row; (2) every state word on those lenses is written at runtime by ONE function from the status src/fixture-seam.mjs resolved, so the static markup contains only an unread fallback and no state claim at all; (3) the four seam states plus did-not-read each produce a DIFFERENT word, shown driving the shipped resolver on real composed regions rather than a copy of it; (4) the lens with no registered domain (Parks) still says its surface does not exist and now says why; (5) the static partition is recomputed from DOMAIN_REGISTRY on every test run and is watched failing on each claim one at a time; (6) both packs and both themes render the correct word, so the lie was not moved from the populated pack to the empty one; (7) CI conclusion string is success.
scopeBasis: The boundary is the CLAIM, not the file and not the word. Four nav badges, four page chips, one register group and one stylesheet dim are in, because each is a rendering of one false claim: that a built lens surface does not exist. Parks, Records search and People and access are OUT because their claim is true and the seam can prove it. The Development services register pill 'Not connected' is OUT because it is a FEED-axis claim that is true on every pack; changing it would have been this lane widening from a finding into a taste. The 'Empty' static fallbacks on Overview, Development services and Finance are OUT because they are the product's pre-existing fallback vocabulary rather than a not-built claim, though they are the same defect one degree weaker and are routed. The Connections register's 70 'Not built' dispositions are OUT because they are bake-owned and answer a different question (where does a JOB live). Nothing was left unmentioned: every claim examined is classified in or out in _inbox/2026-08-20_k3_cp1.json.

The branch produces the byte-identical message. GitHub Actions run 32326231384 on that same commit concluded a11y: success, and this PR's a11y check-run conclusion string is SUCCESS.
freeFinding.reading: this branch adds ZERO a11y failures, measured by comparing the two failure strings rather than by inference. Local and CI disagree on a required gate, and the named elements sit in the nav footer, which G-100 does not touch. Reason elmPartiallyObscuring is axe declining to compute contrast on a partially covered element, which is layout-dependent - a plausible cause is that the Google Fonts stylesheet does not load in this local environment and the sticky .nav-foot lays out differently. NOT chased here: CI is authoritative for merge and the finding is routed.
freeFinding.why it matters: an instrument that is red in one environment and green in another is a gate somebody will eventually learn to ignore, which is DEV_PROCESS rule 0's failure mode. Worth a row.
